extraction.name: EgoLife Dataset
extraction.description: A comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset with intensive annotation, collected from six participants living together for one week to prepare an Earth Day celebration.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Six participants lived together for a seven-day period, each wearing Meta Aria glasses to capture multimodal egocentric videos. Additionally, 15 GoPro cameras provided synchronized third-person perspectives, and millimeter-wave radars provided spatial and motion data.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data includes egocentric video and signals from Meta Aria glasses, third-person video from GoPro cameras, and spatial/motion data from millimeter-wave radars.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Data was synchronized using EgoSync codebase, processed through privacy protection (EgoBlur), dense captioning (EgoCaption), and transcription (EgoTranscript) modules.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A rigorous data cleaning process was implemented to ensure synchronization, participant privacy, and readiness for annotation and data release. This included synchronization of multi-source data, privacy protection (blurring faces, muting sensitive audio), dense captioning, and transcription.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Transcript annotations were generated using speech recognition and diarization, then reviewed and corrected. Caption annotations involved splitting videos into 5-minute clips, slowed to 0.8x speed, with annotators providing continuous narrations converted to text and reviewed. EgoLifeQA annotations were generated by feeding visual-audio captions into GPT-4o to produce timestamped questions, which were then filtered, refined, and curated by human annotators.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Video editing software with dubbing functions (Capcut), speech recognition (Whisper Large v3), diarization algorithm, transcription tool, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: For QA annotation, AI-generated questions from GPT-4o were filtered by annotators to retain only questions requiring information from at least five minutes prior, with a preference for longer dependencies and strong real-world relevance. Annotators also generated distractors, annotated whether audio was required, and specified look-back time (certification length).
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: For EgoLifeQA, 500 QA pairs per participant (total 3K QAs) were curated from an initial pool of 100K AI-generated candidates.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Whisper Large v3, diarization algorithm
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The development of EgoButler and the EgoLifeQA dataset holds significant potential to enhance human-AI interaction, particularly in personalized assistance and context-aware applications, improving quality of life, especially for individuals needing consistent support. However, privacy and ethical considerations must be addressed.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited to a single language (primarily Chinese) and a specific scenario (Earth Day celebration in a shared house), which may affect generalizability. The primary language is Chinese, with a one-day English subset recently collected.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation for developing egocentric AI assistants, specifically for long-context question answering, habit analysis, event recall, entity logging, task tracking, and relationship understanding.
